items.statement: A genuine engine run rewrote the admitted 93-byte springsettings.cfg (57d899...) into a 1,864-byte runtime output (c40b39...), including VSyncGame 0 to -1. The next packet copied and inventoried those post-run bytes, so internal hash consistency masked a provenance break. Mutable runtime material must be separated from immutable packet input, or every successor must restore and reverify admitted pre-run bytes before deriving new identities.
